title: GEOquery (development version)
text: getGEO() gains returnType argument. returnType = "SummarizedExperiment", GSE Series Matrix results returned SummarizedExperiment objects instead ExpressionSet. default remains "ExpressionSet" now (one-time notice) switch "SummarizedExperiment" future release. new exported as_SummarizedExperiment() coerces existing ExpressionSet result without re-downloading. See ADR-0002 (#168). Downloads now stream disk instead buffering entire response memory, retry transient HTTP errors, honor configurable GEOquery.download.timeout option (default 300 seconds) — replacing previous enforced 120-second floor ignored lower user timeouts. Failures raise typed geoquery_download_error carrying URL HTTP status. getDirListing() now uses httr2 layer (#147, #173). GEOquery now raises typed error conditions — geoquery_error subclasses (geoquery_private_accession, geoquery_download_error, geoquery_parse_error, geoquery_bad_accession) — failures can handled programmatically tryCatch() (#170, #184, #186). getGEOSuppFiles() gains quiet argument (defaulting GEOquery.quiet option, FALSE) suppress informational messages “supplemental files found” “Using locally cached version” (#68, #182). getGEOSuppFiles() gains quiet argument (defaulting GEOquery.quiet option, FALSE) suppress informational messages “supplemental files found” “Using locally cached version” (#68, #182).

title: GEOquery (development version)
text: Supplemental-file URLs now built small url_join() helper instead file.path(), mangled https:// https:/ produced double slashes. Affects getGEOSuppFiles(fetch_files = FALSE) getGEOSeriesFileListing() (#131, #178). GDS2eSet() longer fails GDS NA (empty) value ID_REF column (e.g. GDS3666). values replaced usable feature name instead producing “row names contain missing values” (#21, #177). getGEO() now fails clear message accession private, embargoed, yet public (NCBI returns HTML page) instead mis-parsing , older versions, looping. findFirstEntity() also hardened multi-line edge case error unbounded reads (#58, #176). getGEO(parseCharacteristics = FALSE) now actually skips characteristics parsing. flag accepted top level dropped reaching parseGSEMatrix(); now threaded getAndParseGSEMatrices() parseGEO() (#60, #175). Fixed error parsing GSE matrix files malformed empty lines sample metadata (e.g., GSE425). Sample lines now extracted directly using pattern matching avoid issues irregular file formatting.
